questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be tue, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement I: **No powder is a lipstick.

**Statement II: **All lipsticks are creams.

**Statement III: **No cream is a lotion.

**Conclusion I: **No lipstick is a lotion.

**Conclusion II: **No powder is a cream.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Given statement:

I: No powder is a lipstick.

II: All lipsticks are creams.

III: No cream is a lotion.

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da497b5b1e4dbbb123eb34050b7deff71729402ebd5de6e04dfde914df89afd2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/090d452b8c7c6bf645e861480e22a0d1c84d9e536137af9f8a55cde75379ca29.png] 

Conclusion

I: No lipstick is a lotion. - **True **(Because, All lipsticks are creams and No cream is a lotion, so No lipstick is a lotion it is definite)

II: No powder is a cream. - **False **(Because, No powder is a lipstick given but there is no direct relation given between powder and creams)

So, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows".**

questions.question: Eight boys A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a row facing towards the south (not necessarily in the same order). A and H are at extreme ends of the row. E and F are immediate neighbours of B. C is fourth to the left of B. F is to the immediate left of A. D is not the immediate neighbour of C. Who is sitting on the immediate left of B?
questions.solution:
Given: Eight boys A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H.

1) A and H are at extreme ends of the row.

2) E and F are immediate neighbours of B.

3) C is fourth to the left of B.

4) F is to the immediate left of A.

5) D is not the immediate neighbour of C.

Final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7b07bf08d822cc36bbcaa2e28d12567d27dfeb5b29ed1577d382048c61c2bd9.png] 

So, **E** is sitting on the immediate left of B.

Hence, the correct answer is **"E".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth word in the same way as the fourth word is related to the third word and the second word is related to the first word.

BANGLADESH ∶ TAKA ∶∶ ARGENTINA ∶ PESO ∶∶ JAPAN ∶ ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic:** Currency of the country**.

Here,

BANGLADESH : TAKA → TAKA is the currency of BANGLADESH.

Similarly,

ARGENTINA : PESO → PESO is the currency of ARGENTINA.

Similarly,

JAPAN : YEN → YEN is the currency of JAPAN.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
